items.title: Recovering the tail of a graded module over a general Noetherian graded ring: for A Noetherian graded, d the lcm of degrees of generators over A_0, M a finite graded module, X = Proj(A), k in Z: N' = bigoplus_{n >= k} H^0(X, M(n)^tilde) and N = bigoplus_{n >= k} H^0(X, M^tilde(n)) are finite A-modules, there are canonical maps N -> N' and (k small) M -> N', M_n -> N'_n is an isomorphism for n >> 0, and N_n -> N'_n is an isomorphism whenever d divides n.

items.difficulty_reason: Every enumerated part is proved inside the span: (3) comes from Constructions equation multiply-more-generally on global sections; (4) from the graded map of Constructions equation global-sections-more-generally once generator degrees are >= k; (6) via algebra-lemma graded-Noetherian/S-plus-generated reducing to A generated over A_0 by f_1,...,f_r with d = lcm(deg f_i) and Constructions where-invertible; (2) is Lemma coherent-on-proj-general applied to the coherent sheaf M^tilde; (1) is deduced from (2) by the {}^qN = bigoplus H^0(X, M(q)^tilde(n)) decomposition, finiteness of A over A^{(d)} and Noetherianity of A^{(d)}; the vanishing claim K_n = 0 for d | n, n >> 0 is proved by the f_i^{n_ij} x_j = 0 argument on homogeneous generators, and (5) follows by re-running the argument with shifts M(q) (the shift-compatibility of N' noted as immediate from its construction) over the finitely many congruence classes mod d. One named closing: that the composite N^tilde -> M^tilde -> N'^tilde is the displayed isomorphism is marked 'proof omitted; hint: look on standard affine opens'.
